evidence.quote:
git clone -b master https://gitee.com/ascend/apex.git
cd apex/
# 前置：torch已安装，setuptools<=65.7.0（推荐65.7.0），Python 3.7–3.10
bash scripts/build.sh --python=3.7

with amp.autocast():                      # 开启混合精度
    outputs = model(inputs)
    loss = criterion(outputs, labels).to(device)
optimizer.zero_grad()
scaler.scale(loss).backward()             # loss缩放并反向传播
scaler.step(optimizer)                     # 更新参数（自动unscale）
scaler.update()
